description: Lagefestpunkte is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geodaten.bayern.de. Highly precise location points or trigonometric points distributed over the country form the basis for a uniform location fixed point field. Since 2004, the State Office for Digitalization, Broadband and Surveying has only been responsible for location points at hierarchy levels C and D. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Positioning points" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Festpunkt, Grundnetzpunkt, LFP, Freistaat Bayern, gdiby, AdVMIS. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF. The listing shows 2007-12-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
